nodes.label: localStorage Best Score Persistence
nodes.rationale: Buscaminas (best time per difficulty/shape) and Memoria (fewest moves) store records under bestKey() with try/catch because localStorage may be unavailable in private browsing or previews.

nodes.label: SVG Tokens and Pip Dice Pattern
nodes.norm_label: svg tokens and pip dice pattern
nodes.rationale: Parques and Serpientes y Escaleras share tokenSvgMarkup/createTokenSVG/createStaticTokenIcon, PIP_LAYOUT/setDieFace dice rendering, toPct positioning and async sleep-based animations.

nodes.label: Confetti Win Celebration Pattern
nodes.rationale: Every game duplicates resizeConfettiCanvas/launchConfetti/stopConfetti with a requestAnimationFrame loop on a canvas overlay to celebrate wins; no shared module, each page is self-contained.

nodes.label: Self-Contained Single-File Game Pages
